dct_description_sm: Ukraine administrative level 0-4 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset. NOTE: The population statistics common operatioanl dataset (COD-PS-UKR) is only available vis special request. See [Ukraine - Subnational Population Statistics](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ps-ukr). Users should use the 'Request Data' button. This COD-AB was most recently reviewed for accuracy and necessary changes in April 2024. The COD-AB does not require any update. Sourced from State Scientific Production Enterprise “Kartographia” Vetting by Information Technology Outreach Services (ITOS) with funding from USAID. This COD-AB is suitable for database or GIS linkage to the Ukraine [COD-PS](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ps-ukr). An edge-matched (COD-EM) version of this COD-AB is available on [HDX here:](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-em-ukr) Please see the [COD Portal](https://cod.unocha.org/). Administrative level 1 contains 27 feature(s). Administrative level 2 contains 139 feature(s). Administrative level 3 contains 1769 feature(s). Administrative level 4 contains 29707 feature(s).
